fJob.name: f
fJob.description: Select the output format of the response. If no value is provided, the standard HTTP rules apply, i.e., the accept header will be used to determine the format.

fResults.name: f
fResults.description: Select the output format of the response. If no value is provided, the standard HTTP rules apply, i.e., the accept header will be used to determine the format.

typeJobs.name: type
typeJobs.description: Only include jobs of the given type. Use `process` for jobs created by this OGC API Processes server.

processIDJobs.name: processID
processIDJobs.description: Only include jobs whose processID matches one of the given identifiers.

statusJobs.name: status
statusJobs.description: Only include jobs whose status matches one of the given values.

datetimeJobs.name: datetime
datetimeJobs.description: Only include jobs whose `created` timestamp intersects this RFC 3339 instant or interval. Open ends use `..`.

minDurationJobs.name: minDuration
minDurationJobs.description: Only include jobs that ran for at least this many seconds. Running jobs use now minus started; completed jobs use finished minus started.

maxDurationJobs.name: maxDuration
maxDurationJobs.description: Only include jobs that ran for no longer than this many seconds. Running jobs use now minus started; completed jobs use finished minus started.

outputsResults.name: outputs
outputsResults.description: Limit the results document to these output identifiers.

limitJobs.name: limit
limitJobs.description: The optional limit parameter limits the number of jobs that are presented in the response document.

offsetJobs.name: offset
offsetJobs.description: The optional offset parameter identifies the index of the first job in the response in the overall result set. Used by next/prev links.
